FiguresWithBBox_Description: Draws rotated rectangles and ellipses on canvas from API data, computing a precise bounding box for each figure.

NestNext_Description: Developed a full-stack user management and analytics platform using a pnpm monorepo architecture with NestJS/Prisma for the backend API, Next.js (App Router) with Tailwind CSS for the frontend, and a mock external text-analysis service. Implemented role-based access control (Admin, Manager, Analyst) with PostgreSQL database migrations, seeding, and Swagger API documentation. Ensured code quality through comprehensive unit and end-to-end testing using Jest for the API and Vitest for the web application.
UserTable_Description: A full-stack application displaying a filterable, sortable, and paginated user table synced in real time via WebSockets. State management was initially built with NgRx (Redux), then refactored to a session storage service. Includes unit tests for the user listing component.

__unused.Api_Description: A serverless REST API built on Fastify and deployed via AWS Lambda. Acts as a central backend hub connecting multiple microfrontend apps: blog, blog post creator, portfolio, weather app, APOD NASA, analytics, and fitness app. Features authentication, mail service, CORS handling, JWT stateless auth, session management, and connectors to AWS DynamoDB and S3. Fully documented with OpenAPI and Swagger.
__unused.AppliedSystems_Description: Built a Server Driven UI insurance purchase flow using a recursive DFS algorithm to render a nested graph of ~60k-line JSON questions. Contributed to an admin panel, user tracking, statistical charts, and WCAG 2.1 AA compliance in an 8-person international team. Kept the codebase maintainable through code reviews and close collaboration with designers, QA, and backend engineers. Shared knowledge across the team by documenting solutions and helping new developers get up to speed with the question graph. Also focused on rendering performance, keeping the form smooth and responsive despite the large number of nested questions.
__unused.Caregiving: Career break to care for my father during his illness with malignant colon cancer. He passed away in August 2026.
__unused.DesignSystem_Description: A comprehensive React component library for building consistent, scalable applications. Published as an npm package.
__unused.EuropaUbezpieczenia_Description: Maintained and developed an internal insurance policy management system for agents and office workers. Built new modules, integrated payment and data verification systems, and worked across Angular frontend and Java/Groovy backend.
__unused.FLHF_Description: Enhanced an e-commerce site with sliders, carousels, product listings, and a shopping cart. Focused on mobile optimization, SEO, CLS, page speed, and accessibility improvements via Lighthouse audits.
__unused.Nook_Description: A full-stack personal hub built with React, TypeScript, and Fastify. Track household bills and invoices, monitor weather and stock quotes, log gym workouts, and draft blog posts, all in one place. Includes interactive charts and spending analytics. Deployed to GitHub Pages via a CI/CD pipeline.
__unused.Tracker_Description: Real-time person movement monitoring app with GPS noise filtering, backed by serverless AWS infrastructure. Implemented a path-smoothing algorithm that discards unrealistic position jumps and produces a stable, readable route on the map. Location data is processed through AWS Lambda functions, so the app scales automatically without any servers to maintain.
__unused.WBD_Description: Built TVN24.pl from scratch using SSR and an islands architecture with microfrontend React + Web Components. Delivered widgets for stocks, weather, polls, elections, TV guides, and a custom SSR rendering algorithm without external libs.
